name: choir
description: Jewelbox 30 Choir Aahs: the striker is the front board of an oak choir riser with a gold trim strip; behind it stand two rows of robed singers (burgundy robes, white stoles, black folders, round heads with open "aah" mouths), a gap in the middle of the front row where the marble lands, back row raised on a second step.
